blocks.text: Why a Chauffeur Makes Sense in San Juan Capistrano
Three practical reasons, specific to this city.
blocks.html: Three practical reasons, specific to this city.

items: Old Town San Juan Capistrano is pedestrian-scaled with metered street parking only, so wedding shuttles are how groups actually move.
The Mission, Los Rios, Serra Plaza and the hotel sit within a few blocks but spread across a hillside, which makes a continuous loop the sane option.
The city is a half-hour drive from both SNA and the Dana Point coast, so airport transfers and coastal add-ons combine easily.
Pacific Coast Highway and Camino Capistrano are the only arteries and both choke at school and church hours.

blocks.text: Choosing a Vehicle for a San Juan Capistrano Night

Capacity is the first filter, then cost per person. A stretch limo seats 6 to 8, a Chrysler 300 about 8, a Hummer 12, and a Sprinter limo up to 14. Our party bus seats 24. Below about ten people, two cars or a limo usually beats a bus. Above ten, the bus wins on cost per head and nobody gets left behind.
